text_en: A parent waits at the school gate.
text_zh: 一位家长在校门口等候。

text_en: My friend sits next to me.

text_zh: 我们的老师讲了一个故事。

text_en: I put the book on the desk.
There is a bag under the desk.
Today we have an English lesson.
text_zh: 今天我们有一节英语课。

text_en: It is sunny after the rain.
I read a short story at night.

text_zh: 请在这里写下你的名字。

text_en: A small bird sits by the window.
Can you help me carry this box?
text_zh: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？

text_en: The garden is beautiful in spring.
